meta.source: Wu et al. 2020 (GSE139555), tumor CD8 T cells
meta.stateRule: X: terminal score >= 75th pct; S: stem-like >= 75th pct; else E
meta.reactiveRule: mean tumor-reactivity score in top quarter of tumor clones with >= 3 cells
meta.enrichedRule: >= 3 tumor cells and >= 4x higher frequency in tumor than in normal adjacent tissue (TCR only)
